# relationship preservation depends on FROM-side survivorship

Relationships present in current but missing from candidate are only removed when their FROM-side is not in the survivor set. This design can cause relationships to persist unexpectedly if the FROM entity is an unobserved survivor, potentially leaving stale edges.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/diff.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.diff.compute_diff`
